# exo_eop_protection_policy_rule (Resource)

Manages the EOPProtectionPolicyRule object via New-EOPProtectionPolicyRule / Get-EOPProtectionPolicyRule / Set-EOPProtectionPolicyRule / Remove-EOPProtectionPolicyRule.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `anti_phish_policy` (String) Maps to the -AntiPhishPolicy parameter.
- `hosted_content_filter_policy` (String) Maps to the -HostedContentFilterPolicy parameter.
- `malware_filter_policy` (String) Maps to the -MalwareFilterPolicy parameter.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
- `except_if_recipient_domain_is` (Set of String) Maps to the -ExceptIfRecipientDomainIs parameter.

- `except_if_sent_to_member_of` (Set of String) Maps to the -ExceptIfSentToMemberOf parameter.
- `recipient_domain_is` (Set of String) Maps to the -RecipientDomainIs parameter.
- `sent_to` (Set of String) Maps to the -SentTo parameter.
- `sent_to_member_of` (Set of String) Maps to the -SentToMemberOf parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
